title: Scape: Scalable Collaborative Analytics System on Private Database with Malicious Security
motivation: 隐私法规和数据竞争阻碍多源数据库联合分析，现有MPC方案在大规模数据上性能不堪用
problem_framing: 构建支持通用SQL操作且容忍最多一个恶意方的高效协作分析系统，核心瓶颈是join操作的O(n²)复杂度
key_insight: 通过oblivious permutation替代oblivious sorting，结合parallel prefix network将traversal轮复杂度从O(n)降至O(log n)，join代价降至O(n log² n + m)
method_signature: 基于(3,2)-replicated sharing构建六步general join协议，配合permutation优化和并行化traversal
evaluation_criteria: 端到端查询延迟和通信量，对比SMCQL/Senate/Secrecy，在TPC-H benchmark上验证可扩展性
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 需公开join结果大小上界m，否则需存O(n²)规模的秘密份额；m泄露是高效方案的不可避免代价
evidence_for_taste: making Scape practical even for large datasets
the poor asymptotic complexity was the major obstacle
we do not always need sorting when we are using it
this undesired leak can be avoided by sending
thinking_moves: 把general join的O(n²)代价归因于需要oblivious sorting的电路规模，进而追问排序是否真正必要
将traversal过程建模为迭代函数，通过引入额外indicator array使其满足结合律，从而可并行化
识别permutation-like key vector场景，用半咸安全oblivious permutation绕过完整排序
先从Krastnikov等的电路出发，再针对secret sharing的通信/轮复杂度做定制优化
